Wiring diagram (SCHEMA ZAPOJENÍ) 568-70.9001 · MS80PS,DS MS115PS,DS · sheet 3 of 8: supply circuits (NAPÁJECÍ OBVODY) · redrawn 2026 from photos (20261113_232117.jpg), not an original document · drawn by schemes_2d/power_draw.py from netlist/power_*.csv
FF1 [?] light curtain: option, not fitted;
Board parts R14, V14 = UG50/R14, UG50/V14 in netlist/power_*.csv:
the names R14 and V14 also name other parts, on sheets 7 and 5.
power-supply board (PLOŠNÝ SPOJ SE ZDROJI), dashed = board outline
Windings: I 21V 120VA -> +27 V DC; II 19V 50VA -> +24 V DC; IV 24V 120VA -> +33 V DC; V 24V 100VA -> ~24 V; VI 48V 180VA -> ~48 V; III unused.
Outputs 3, 8, 9, 15, 16 printed without destination. V13, V23 (ranges V11-V17, V21-V27) are not drawn: winding III has no fuse.
Indicator pairs drawn anti-parallel; diode polarity not read. C4: photo shows a blue SAMWHA 4700µF 63V over the empty board places C3/C4: a repair (c144231), on-site list.
The X5 list (2:02) names 9UG50, this sheet prints 8 and 9 unused: conflict, on-site list.
